title: Sketching Language Models for Context Attribution
abstract: arXiv:2611.17313v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Context attribution asks how removing parts of a prompt changes a language model's output. We study leave-one-out (LOO) attribution for a prompt of $n$ tokens and a fixed measurement function. Computing all LOO values directly requires $n$ model evaluations. Under a stability assumption, our algorithm estimates all LOO values to error proportional to $\varepsilon$ with constant probability using $O(\sqrt{\log(1/\varepsilon)}/\varepsilon)$ evaluation calls. To complement our upper bound, we prove a matching $\Omega(\sqrt{\log(1/\varepsilon)}/\varepsilon)$ lower bound on the number of evaluation calls in an oracle model. Empirically, we verify coefficient decay consistent with stability and evaluate the performance of our sketching algorithm on a small language-model retrieval task.   Technically, our result is based on a sketching algorithm for arithmetic circuits whose Taylor coefficients satisfy the stability condition recently introd

translated_title: 用于上下文归因的语言模型草图算法
translated_abstract: 上下文归因研究的问题是：移除提示词的部分内容会如何改变语言模型的输出。我们研究了针对包含 n 个词元的提示在固定测量函数下的留一法（LOO）归因。直接计算所有 LOO 值需要 n 次模型评估。在稳定性假设下，我们的算法仅需 O(√(log(1/ε))/ε) 次评估调用，即可在常数概率下将所有 LOO 值估计到与 ε 成正比的误差范围内。作为对上界的补充，我们在预言机模型中证明了匹配的 Ω(√(log(1/ε))/ε) 评估调用次数下界。在实证方面，我们验证了与稳定性假设相一致的系数衰减现象，并在一个小型语言模型检索任务上评估了草图算法的性能。在技术层面，我们的结果基于一个针对算术电路的草图算法，该电路的泰勒系数满足最近提出的稳定性条件。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于草图算法的上下文归因方法，在稳定性假设下仅需 O(√(log(1/ε))/ε) 次模型评估即可估计所有留一法（LOO）归因值，远低于直接计算所需的 n 次评估，并给出了匹配的理论下界。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a sketching algorithm that, under a stability assumption, estimates all leave-one-out (LOO) context attribution values for language models using only O(√(log(1/ε))/ε) evaluation calls instead of n, with a matching lower bound proved.
